content: Existence of a parameter in the Ecuc Parameter Value de- scription in case the upperMultiplicity of the parameter definition is zero If the upperMultiplicity of a parameter definition in the VSMD is 0, the parameter may be omitted in the parameter Value description. If such a parameter exists in the param- eter Value description it shall be ignored by the tool (5).
